_sources.discrepancies: No major discrepancies found. Maine uses ranked-choice voting for federal and statewide offices. NCSL classifies Maine as no-document-required for ID. [2026-06-10] Primary date June 9, 2026 confirmed (FVAP 2026 primary calendar; Maine SoS). General Nov 3 confirmed. Registration deadlines remain statutory estimates (15 business days before the election) - confirm exact dates with your town clerk.

earlyVoting.notes: In-person absentee voting at your town/city clerk's office begins once ballots are available (about 30 days before Election Day). Confirm exact dates with your town or city clerk: https://www.maine.gov/sos/cec/elec/index.html

In-person absentee voting (Maine's form of early voting) begins once ballots are available, about 30 days before Election Day, at town/city clerks' offices. Confirm exact dates with your town or city clerk: https://www.maine.gov/sos/cec/elec/index.html

Maine offers in-person absentee voting at town/city clerks' offices beginning about 30 days before the election. Confirm exact dates with your town or city clerk: https://www.maine.gov/sos/cec/elec/index.html

votingRules.phonesAtPollsDetail: Maine law does not prohibit phones inside polling places. Photography of other voters without consent is not permitted. Electioneering is prohibited within 250 feet of the polling place entrance.
additionalRules: Maine uses ranked-choice voting (RCV) for federal offices (U.S. Senate, U.S. House) and statewide offices (Governor, etc.). Voters rank candidates in order of preference.
Same-day voter registration is available; bring proof of identity and residency.
Undeclared (unenrolled) voters may request a party primary ballot on Election Day.

eligibility: Any registered voter may request an absentee ballot without providing a reason (no-excuse absentee)
voteByMail.applicationDeadline: 3 business days before the election (received by town/city clerk)
voteByMail.returnDeadline: Must be received by the town/city clerk by the close of polls on Election Day
voteByMail.returnDeadlinePlain: Must arrive at the clerk's office by 8 p.m. on Election Day. Postmarks do not count.

primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEn: Maine has a semi-closed primary (Me. Rev. Stat. Title 21-A, §341). Registered party members vote in their party's primary. Voters enrolled as 'unenrolled' may participate in either party's primary without formally joining that party.
primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEs: Maine tiene una primaria semi-cerrada (Me. Rev. Stat. Title 21-A, §341). Los miembros registrados en un partido votan en la primaria de su partido. Los votantes inscritos como 'sin inscripción' pueden participar en la primaria de cualquier partido sin afiliarse formalmente.
